cards.title: EUCAST ECOFF Definition and Derivation
cards.claim: ECOFFs (and TECOFFs) distinguish microorganisms without (wild type) and with phenotypically detectable acquired resistance mechanisms. ECOFFs are based on at least 5 distributions, while TECOFFs are based on 3 or 4.
conditions: Applicable for distinguishing wild-type vs non-wild-type phenotypes
Requires sufficient distribution data (>=5 for ECOFF, 3-4 for TECOFF)
required_inputs: Curated data compliant with EUCAST SOP 10
limitations: Do not represent rates of resistance
Based on phenotypic detection of acquired resistance mechanisms
cards.downstream_use: Used as reference material for epidemiological surveillance and as a basis for clinical breakpoint decisions.

note: Method/reference scope retained; source identity is available in original evidence.
